prompt:
Desktop web application screen, 16:9, LIGHT theme, premium modern fintech product UI, flat design with crisp detail (not a photograph). Product: "Valuta", salaries agreed in pesos paid in USDC at the rate that was live on payday. Layout:
1) Slim top bar: wordmark "Valuta", links "Payrolls", "New payroll", "Rate lookup", live dot "Arc mainnet", petrol (#0B4F6C) "Connect wallet".
2) Top-left, large confident heading: "The rate was set on payday. Lateness can't change it." with a small line: "Payroll 1 · MXN 1.00 per day · 11 payslips · all held".
3) A full-width VALUE-DATE TIMELINE across the upper half: a long horizontal time ribbon from 15 Oct to 25 Oct, with a thin ink line of the MXN/USD rate stepping at each Chainlink round. Eleven petrol rubber-stamp markers sit on the ribbon at each payday 14:00, labelled "01" to "11". A draggable cursor stands at 15 Oct 14:00 with a label "VALUE 15 OCT 14:00 · round 292 · 0.05389760". At the far right, a cluster of carbon-blue settlement marks: "settled 25 Oct 13:59".
4) Lower half, the selected PAYSLIP as a wide security document on white paper with a fine guilloché background:
   - Left part: the petrol stamp "VALUE 15 OCT 2026 · 14:00 UTC", "No. 01 of 20".
   - Middle: the huge monospace amount "0.053897 USDC", with "0.053567 if priced when it settled" struck through beneath.
   - Right part: a round embossed seal "RATE HELD" and three check lines: "Round 292 live at 14:00", "Round 293 at 14:06", "10 min old, limit 25 h".
   - Bottom line in monospace: "settled by 0xe5CA…aBC3, not the employer · tx 0x82ff…38b7 · Verify on Arc".
Palette: cool white #F6F8F9, paper white, ink #0E1B26, petrol #0B4F6C, carbon blue #2E3F8F for figures. No gradients, no glow, no dark. Crisp legible text.
